about.title: About Cattleya
about.p1: Cattleya B&B takes its name from a tropical flower symbolizing elegance and beauty.
about.p2: Like this rare and fascinating flower, we want to offer our guests a special place in the heart of Milano: a warm, well-kept environment with an almost familiar atmosphere, where you can immediately feel at home.
about.p3: Choosing Cattleya means experiencing Milano with the comfort, tranquility and attention that only authentic hospitality can offer.

location.title: Location
location.preview: Cattleya Bed & Breakfast is located in the heart of the NoLo district, in northeast Milano, at via Perticari, on the corner of via Padova, a lively and multicultural street full of all kinds of venues: restaurants, shops, supermarkets, pharmacies and banks.
location.intro: Cattleya Bed & Breakfast is located in the heart of the NoLo district, in northeast Milano, at via Perticari, on the corner of via Padova, a lively and multicultural street full of all kinds of venues: restaurants, shops, supermarkets, pharmacies and banks. It is 400 meters from the Cimiano metro station (Green Line) and just a short walk from the Martesana Park. It is 2 km from the entrance to the Milano East Ring Road, which provides quick access to the airports of Linate (now also reachable via the M4 metro) and Orio al Serio.
location.transport: This strategic location allows you to conveniently reach the city center in just a few minutes thanks to frequent metro connections that quickly take you to areas of great interest such as the Duomo, Brera and Porta Venezia.
location.hospital: The property is located near the San Raffaele Hospital, easily reachable in 15 minutes, making it ideal for those traveling for health reasons.
location.park: The immediate proximity to the Martesana Park offers the opportunity to enjoy pleasant walks, cycling paths and moments of relaxation surrounded by greenery.

metro.distance: Only 400 meters from the Cattleya B&B
metro.direction: Direction Cascina Gobba / Gessate / Cologno Nord

paragraphs.p1: The spacious Cattleya room is a comfortable and versatile choice, perfect for accommodating up to 2 guests thanks to a convenient French-style sofa bed. Located on the 6th floor of a building with an elevator, it offers a stunning view of the Milano skyline and is furnished in a modern style with bright, carefully detailed interiors.
paragraphs.p2: The room is equipped with all essential comforts — TV, air conditioning, mosquito screens and Wi-Fi — and is designed to ensure practicality and independence during your stay. With a simple gesture, the bed can be folded back into a comfortable sofa, making the space even more roomy and livable.
paragraphs.p3: The kitchenette, fully equipped, features a refrigerator, microwave, two induction hobs, kettle, dishes and pots, perfect for preparing meals in complete independence.
paragraphs.p4: The private bathroom is complete with a spacious shower, hair dryer and washing machine.
paragraphs.p5: Completing the apartment, a large furnished terrace offers a pleasant and private space where you can relax outdoors and enjoy moments of tranquillity during your stay.

paragraphs.p1: This charming 30 sqm studio is located on the 6th floor of a building with an elevator and enjoys a stunning view of the Milano skyline — from the rooftops of old Milano near Via Padova and the Naviglio Martesana, all the way to the new skyline of Piazza Gae Aulenti with the Unicredit Tower.
paragraphs.p2: The studio, equipped with every comfort — TV, air conditioning and Wi-Fi — features a large room furnished in a modern style. The space is set up to accommodate 2 guests: the two single beds can be joined to form a comfortable double bed.
paragraphs.p3: A self-contained unit houses a fully equipped kitchenette: refrigerator, microwave, two induction hobs. The bathroom with window is equipped with a spacious shower, hair dryer and courtesy products.
paragraphs.p4: The highlight is the furnished terrace with table and chairs to dine outdoors, complemented by a small veranda.

paragraphs.p1: The Sakura room is a welcoming and functional choice, ideal for accommodating one guest. Set in a quiet and bright space on the 6th floor of a building with an elevator, it is furnished in a modern style with attention to detail to offer a comfortable and relaxing stay.
paragraphs.p2: The room is equipped with all essential comforts — TV, air conditioning, mosquito screens and Wi-Fi — designed to ensure practicality and independence during your stay.
paragraphs.p3: The kitchenette, fully equipped, features a refrigerator, microwave, two induction hobs and kettle, perfect for preparing meals in complete independence.
paragraphs.p4: The private bathroom is complete with shower, hair dryer and courtesy products.
paragraphs.p5: Completing the apartment, a large furnished terrace with table and chairs offers a pleasant and private space where you can relax outdoors, read a book or enjoy moments of tranquillity during your stay.
